_about: OpenRouter :free models in fallback order (priority 1 is tried first). The backend resolves each display
name to its exact id from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models at startup; vision and response_format
support come from the catalog too. Rows that disappear from this list are disabled in the database.
Left out on purpose: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety (a moderation classifier, not a chat model).
Check the key and every model with: npm run models:check (or POST /jobs/llm-check on the server).
